tasks.title: The lite window
tasks.objective: Generalize the quickfix window (forge_cli/quickfix.py) into a mode with a `profile` field (quickfix|lite) and, for lite, a `base_sha` at open. Add `forge mode lite|list|done` (mode lite needs --by/--reason); the closer dispatches by profile (quickfix unchanged; lite records the manifest, full gate added in .3). No `mode full`. Authorization is unchanged (an open window already authorizes); add session_start/phase banners naming an open lite window and its 'one review to close' state.
acceptance_criteria: `forge mode lite --by X --reason Y` opens a window recorded with profile=lite and base_sha=HEAD; `forge mode list` shows it; `forge mode done` closes it (records the manifest); there is no `mode full` subcommand.
While a lite window is open, a product Edit/Write is authorized by pre_tool_use.py exactly as an open quickfix window authorizes it.
`quickfix start/done/list` behavior is unchanged (profile defaults to quickfix).
session_start.py and `forge next` name an open lite window and state that one review is required to close it.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "mode or lite_window or quickfix"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Reuse of the quickfix window/ledger/authorization rather than a parallel mechanism; quickfix profile fully unchanged; base_sha captured at open; no over-broad CLI (only lite|list|done).

tasks.title: The lite fix path (terra@high)
tasks.objective: Add `forge fix "<desc>"` (forge_cli/fix.py, wired in forge.py) requiring an open lite window; compose a minimal brief and launch the companion --write reusing delegate.py's launch/reap/ledger helpers. Model/effort come from a new mode_run_config over a `modes.lite` block in harness.yaml (gpt-5.6-terra/high/bound 5), not pinned_run_config. Lite-fix rows key `task` to the window id; extend delegation.json to accept it. No auto-commit; record touched files via record_files.
acceptance_criteria: `forge fix "<desc>"` refuses with no open lite window.
With an open lite window, the recorded delegation row shows model=gpt-5.6-terra, effort=high, write=true, and task=<lite window id>; the row validates against factory/schemas/delegation.json.
The model/effort are sourced from harness.yaml modes.lite, not the implementation pin; `python3 factory/scripts/check_dual_runtime.py` stays green.
`forge fix` does not create a git commit.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "fix or modes_lite or delegation"
tasks.reviewer_focus: forge fix reuses delegate's launch/reap/ledger verbatim (inherits normalize-ps-derived-identity and the launch- prefix); it carries none of the 0018 stage-done gates by design; model override reads modes.lite; no decomposition/stage coupling leaks in.

tasks.title: The lite close gate
tasks.objective: Complete the lite `mode done` gate in quickfix.py: refuse a dirty product tree; measure the committed base_sha->HEAD diff and refuse over the bound; require the three review artifacts stamped at HEAD with no blockers (reuse a helper extracted from pr_ready into factory_lib). Add a `lite_window_ok` path passed ONLY by record_review so review recording accepts an open lite window; the shared gate() stays strict for verify/tests. On close, append the manifest and archive the reviews (0025).
acceptance_criteria: `forge mode done` on a lite window refuses when the product working tree is dirty ('commit the fix first').
`forge mode done` refuses when the committed base_sha->HEAD diff touches more distinct product files than the bound, and passes at or under it.

`forge mode done` refuses without the three review artifacts stamped at HEAD with no blocking findings, and passes with them, recording a non-empty file manifest and archiving the reviews into the ledger record.
record_review_from_json.py records a review under an open lite window with no approved plan/decomposition; a lite window does NOT unlock verify.py or record_test recording (shared gate stays strict).
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "mode_done or lite_review or lite_window or gate"
tasks.reviewer_focus: The lite_window_ok relaxation is scoped to review recording ONLY (verify/tests stay strict — assert it); budget measured on the committed diff not the working tree; dirty-tree refusal; evidence archived on close so .factory/reviews does not linger.

tasks.title: Contract + docs
tasks.objective: Make the contract reflect the third exit: 0013 names lite as a third planning-lock exit; 0003 gains a one-line 'see 0031' cross-ref; WORKFLOW.md gets a Modes subsection; factory-entry-contract lists three exits; the /forge skill maps 'use lite mode' to `forge mode lite`. The skill edit gives the stage a product diff; no doc claims the code doesn't implement.
acceptance_criteria: docs/decisions/0013 and docs/memory/factory-entry-contract.md describe three planning-lock exits (approved plan, quickfix, lite window).
docs/decisions/0003 carries a one-line cross-reference to 0031's lite-mode terra-write extension.
WORKFLOW.md documents modes (full/lite) and the /forge skill maps 'use lite mode' to `forge mode lite`.
`python3 factory/scripts/check_dual_runtime.py` stays green after the doc/skill edits.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "docs_third_exit or forge_skill_lite"
tasks.reviewer_focus: The /forge skill provides a real product diff so the stage is not docs-only; 0003 gains a cross-ref (not a rewrite); no behavior claims in docs that the code does not implement; dual-runtime reference-not-duplicate stays intact.
